overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Main issues were duplicate model names and inconsistent formatting. The paper focuses on truthfulness evaluation in multilingual question answering, with strong emphasis on LLM-as-a-Judge methodology. BLEU/BLEURT/BERTScore metrics were only used for MT quality evaluation, not for evaluating the generated answers, so they were correctly excluded from Q2.
